fr_html: Mr. ROOT donne quelques explications complémentaires sur sa proposition; il s'agit de „concurrent votes" par l'Assemblée et le Conseil.
en_html: Mr. ROOT gave a further explanation of his proposal, saying that "concurrent votes" of the Assembly and the Council should take place.
